results.content: Certificate in Biblical Languages Courses Course Title Credit Hours Required: HEBR 1111-1114 Elementary Biblical Hebrew I 4 HEBR 1121-1124 Elementary Biblical Hebrew II 4 Elementary Ancient Greek: 8 GREK 1101-1102 Elementary Ancient Greek OR GREK 1111-1114 Elementary Ancient Greek I GREK 1121-1124 Elementary Ancient Greek II Total for certificate in Biblical Languages 16 Chinese Studies Minor Courses Course Title Credit Hours Required: CHIN 1106 Modern Chinese Literature 4 CHIN 2201, 2202 Intermediate Chinese I, II 8 HIST 2221 Modern China 4 One of the following*: 4 CHIN 1105 Chinese Culture through Film CPHL 2251 Chinese Philosophy HIST 1123 East Asia to 1600 HIST 1124 East Asia 1600 to Present POL 1115 Introduction to East Asian Politics and Culture Total for minor in Chinese Studies 20 *With advisor approval, appropriate study abroad courses may be included Classical Studies Minor Courses Course Title Credit Hours Required: CLAS 1132 Classical Mythology 4 CLAS 1183 Classical Rhetoric and Persuasive Power 4 Three additional courses from: 12 Any Classics course Any Latin courses at the 2200 level or above Total for Minor in Classical Studies 20 Latin Minor Courses Course Title Credit Hours Required: LATN 2201, 2202 Intermediate Latin 8 Three Latin courses at the 3300 level 12 Total for Minor in Latin 20 Recommended Courses for the minors in Classical Studies and Latin Art History courses, particularly, ARTH 1101, ARTH 1102, and ARTH 2261; Comparative Philosophy courses, particularly CPHL 1111; History courses, particularly those that deal with Europe and Europe’s impact on the rest of the world.
